content.headline: Synthetically Generated Information (SGI) — what the rules expect
content.body: IT Rules amendments (notified Feb 2026) treat deepfakes and other AI-altered audio/visual content as SGI. Platforms must label it clearly; officers must verify before they amplify.
bullets: SGI must carry a persistent label for its entire duration — not a one-time watermark that can be stripped
Where feasible, provenance / metadata should identify synthetic origin
Worst non-consensual intimate deepfake content: platforms face a 2-hour takedown window
IndiaAI Governance Guidelines (Nov 2025): Do No Harm — human judgment still decides sensitive-data use
Your duty: label official synthetic media, verify viral forwards via official channels, escalate — do not amplify
